_comment: Demo lending policy (PRODUCT 'Loan Policy', DESIGN §9): the per-acre rate for
each supported crop, loaded by the verifier's Agriculture decision module.
Version-controlled on purpose. The rate is what turns verified acreage into a
rupee figure shown to a customer, so it must be reviewable in Git rather than
living in code or a database someone can edit between demos.
maxRatePerAcre is the ceiling PRODUCT sets for the demo policy. It is checked
when this file loads: a rate above it is a startup failure, not a silently
accepted higher limit. A crop absent from `rates` is NOT a failure — it is a
verified business answer, NOT ELIGIBLE, because the registry's controlled
vocabulary deliberately contains crops this policy does not lend against.
Rates are whole rupees per acre. Not a real lending policy.
